text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Right, a weapon isn't always something 
visible on the surface.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(It's not just about toughness or a sharp 
burst of speed; it's a test of the 
"weapons of the heart" as well.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Opera O-chan's "confidence." Ayabe-san's 
"reckless determination"...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(What do I have to do to surpass that at 
the 'Kikuka Sho'...)

With only a little time left until the 
Kikuka-sho, Narita Top Road had become 
lost in a labyrinth of her own mind.
choice_data_list: Are you still feeling troubled?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes... I just don't know what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If it's a visible weapon, I might be able 
to confront it just like I did during the 
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
However... you can't see the heart. When 
it comes to things you can't see, I have 
no idea how to change them...
choice_data_list: Top Road...

text_block_list.text:
I try to offer comforting words, but... I 
can't. Because I don't have the answer 
myself.

Narita Top Road is a textbook honor 
student. She doesn't possess the kind of 
"peculiarity" those other two have.
choice_data_list: ......Sorry, I'm gonna step out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

I felt so useless. As a trainer, I 
couldn't find the right words to say. It's 
pathetic that I couldn't solve this on my 
own, but—

Even so, there was still a way. If it's 
come to this— there was no choice but to 
rely on "that person."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yo, long time no see. What's up? Why the 
long face?

The teacher welcomed me with their usual 
aloof demeanor. Yes――

This is the mentor who taught Narita Top 
Road and me the fundamentals of racing.
choice_data_list:
Please tell me about this "weapon of the 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, a weapon of the heart, eh? Well, take 
a seat.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I see. It's true that Narita Top Road 
isn't an Umamusume with any sharp, flashy 
edges.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Back when I taught him as a kid, he never 
gave me a lick of trouble. A good boy, 
really.
choice_data_list: You have a point...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: —Still, though.

The teacher's eyes glinted sharply for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Just because it's not edgy doesn't make it 
ordinary. I feel like that's missing the 
point too.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's go check things out. Show me 
the way to Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.text:
The two of us watch Narita Top Road from 
afar. Narita Top Road is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: One... two... One... two...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can't see the road ahead... But basic 
stamina has got to be important. One, 
two...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought. Look at her. No 
matter how troubled she is, no matter how 
much pain she's in...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I try to do "what I can" to the "best of 
my ability." Both in training and in the 
real race.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, she can run hard 
all the way through, from the start of the 
race to the very finish.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: She's not a biased kid. She's not, but...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Astonishingly straightforward." Isn't 
that a formidable "weapon of the heart" in 
its own right?
choice_data_list: Astonishingly... straightforward...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is 10 dashes! Varying the 
pace with each and every run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Persisting without losing heart" is 
something few can actually do. And I've 
seen plenty of girls in my time.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen it? Have you ever seen 
that girl give up?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If it's the Narita Top Road I know, that 
can't be right. She's—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
As long as you charge straight ahead, you 
can go toe-to-toe with any crazy bastard 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why they are—"hope".
choice_data_list: Which is precisely why... there is hope...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that finally woke me up. Even 
Narita Top Road has a weapon in her heart. 
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something that has been there since 
childhood. Something I've held onto, 
unchanged, even now...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And that's precisely the kind of person 
she is... Look, see for yourself over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Class Rep!! You're looking 
super good out there--!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You can definitely, absolutely win!! Give 
it your all—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
People will show up who'll cheer for you 
from the bottom of their hearts. They're 
the ones who give you strength. A strength 
you don't have on your own.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And, well... that's about the logic behind 
the weapon in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Logic is just logic, though. It takes more 
than that to move someone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: The rest... depends on your passion.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think you can tell them?
choice_data_list: ...Yes! I'll make sure to tell them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How much I can believe in Narita Top 
Road's brilliance. How powerfully I can 
convey just how wonderful and valuable it 
is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without passion, nothing can reach others. 
That held true for both Umamusume and 
Trainers alike.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: See ya. I'm looking forward to the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The teacher patted me on the shoulder and 
quietly walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Welcome back. I was just 
doing some self-practice...
choice_data_list: Top Road, can we talk for a moment?
Top Road, can we talk for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the Trainer's office. I had to 
convey my feelings with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not in the teacher's words――but in her 
own.
choice_data_list: You have a weapon in your heart too!
You have a weapon in your heart, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I poured all my passion into my words. 
Everything I realized after talking with 
the teacher, expressed in my own voice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road stood straight as a rod 
the entire time while listening.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...-san... You had that kind of 
talk... with Sensei...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! Thank you! I am... 
just so honored.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"It turns out I just didn't fully believe 
in myself. How pathetic of me..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through that thick thread—the bond of 
hearts that had been nurtured with Narita 
Top Road up to this day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My words had reached her. Narita Top Road 
seemed ready to take another look at 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have a weapon to ensure victory. If only 
I could figure out what it is...
choice_data_list:
Top Road, let's run a race we won't 
regret!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So that I won't have any regrets...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's run however you want!
Yeah, let's run just the way you want!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The running style I love— isn't 
anything special.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Running all-out from start to finish, 
giving it my absolute all. Even if—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Even over the long distance of 3,000m!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given how long the race is, how 
consistently you run throughout every 
section will significantly impact the 
final outcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And there was something I simply had to 
tell Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't something I discussed with the 
teacher— this is my own wish as a 
Trainer."
choice_data_list:
I want your radiance to be number one 
above all.
I want your brilliance to be number one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: My radiance is... number one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Excessive obsession must never be the 
ideal. If it becomes the model to follow, 
everyone will strive for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Building things up steadily is the true 
royal road. To prove that, I wanted her to 
give her absolute best run.
choice_data_list: Show me what we should strive to become.

I want you to show me what we should 
strive to become.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand! If that is Trainer's 
wish, and everyone else's...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I will show you! The ideal me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road stands tall and 
dependable. Her expression carries a 
dignity unlike ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, preparations for the final battle 
of the Classic Road were complete. The 
stage of the Chrysanthemum awaits the 
three who have grown.
